documentNotes.title: Star chart
documentNotes.statement:
You have 30 minutes to finish this part.

Please use only a pencil to make the drawings and markings.

After you finish the work fill your student ID on the answer sheet as well as on the sky map.

Put the answersheets in the folder; leave the compass, the ruler and the pencil on the table.

Thank you!

In this part you will use the sky-map found in the envelope. The map represents the sky in Suceava (Latitude $47^{0}$ 39’ North, Longitude $26^{0}$ 15’ East) on the day of the test at 22:00 local time. The observer who made the sky-map was at a very high altitude above Suceava; the Zenith point is in the center of the chart. Please use a pencil for marking and drawing lines on the sky-map. Use the example 1, 2 and 3 to draw lines and mark objects on the map, as seen in the figure below.

problems.statement: Draw on the map the horizon for an observer located on the ground in Suceava.

figures.alt: Framed heading „HOW TO DRAW AND MARK ON THE SKY-MAP“ above an example sky-map: the upper half of a circular star chart with the directions N, NE, NW, E and W on its rim. Three example markings are shown: MARKING 1 — a drawn curve labelled „The equatorial parallel“ ("This is how you will draw the curves/lines and indicate what it represents."); MARKNG 2 — a constellation outline marked with the letter B ("This is how you will mark the constelations. The letter corresponds to the name of the constellation according to table 1."); MARKING 3 — a cross on a star labelled with the number 5 ("This is how you will mark the planets or stars. Number of the body, star, planet etc.").
